proposals.before: A year later he was appointed military governor of Bianfang.
proposals.after: A year later he was appointed military governor of Fufang (鄜坊).
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄜坊 is the Fufang circuit; English 'Bianfang' is a mistranscription.

proposals.before: Within a year he was appointed military governor of Bianfang.
proposals.after: Within a year he was appointed military governor of Fufang (鄜坊).
proposals.reason: Literal field repeats the same place-name error as idiomatic.

proposals.before: In the eleventh year of his rule he was killed by his own troops.
proposals.after: In year eleven (Xiantong 11) he was killed by his own troops.
proposals.reason: Chinese 十一年 is regnal year eleven (Xiantong 11), not 'eleventh year of his rule'.

proposals.before: In Taihe 2 (828) the Cangjing military governor Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie seized the garrison city, petitioned for the commissioner's credentials, and Xiancheng raised an army against him.
proposals.after: In Taihe 2 (828) the Cangjing military governor Li Quanlue died. His son Tongjie seized the garrison city, petitioned for the commissioner's credentials, and an army was raised to campaign against him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 舉兵伐之 does not name Xiancheng as the attacker; English invents Xiancheng as subject.

proposals.before: Before long the court sent Secretariat Director Wei Wenke as imperial envoy to offer reassurance.
proposals.after: Before long the court sent Director of the Bureau of Gates Wei Wenke as imperial envoy to offer reassurance.
proposals.reason: 司門郎中 is Director of the Bureau of Gates, not Secretariat Director.

proposals.before: Soon the court dispatched Secretariat Director Wei Wenke to proclaim consolation.
proposals.after: Soon the court dispatched Director of the Bureau of Gates Wei Wenke to proclaim consolation.
proposals.reason: Literal repeats the same office mistranslation.

proposals.before: On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou 2, yamen guard deputy Li Gongxian mutinied, and Wei barely escaped with his life.
proposals.after: On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou 2, yamen guard deputy Li Gongquan mutinied, and Wei barely escaped with his life.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李公佺 uses 佺 (quán); English Gongxian misreads the given name.

proposals.before: On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou year two, yamen guard army deputy commander Li Gongxian made disorder; Wei barely escaped with his person.
proposals.after: On the night of the thirteenth day of the seventh month of Tianyou year two, yamen guard army deputy commander Li Gongquan made disorder; Wei barely escaped with his person.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李公佺 uses 佺 (quán); English Gongxian misreads the given name.
Short form should match 公佺 (Gongquan), not Gongxian.

proposals.before: Quanzhong's daughter had been married to Wei's son Tinggui, who had recently died.
proposals.after: Quanzhong's daughter had been married to Wei's son Tinggui; she had earlier died.
proposals.reason: 先是卒 refers to Quanzhong's daughter (全忠女), not Tinggui; the literal rendering is correct.

decisions.after: A year later he was appointed military governor of Fufang.
decisions.reason: s0049 授鄜坊節度使 names the Fufang circuit; Bianfang misreads 鄜 as if 汴, but the proposed English must not embed the Chinese characters (鄜坊).

decisions.after: Within a year he was appointed military governor of Fufang.
decisions.reason: s0049 鄜坊 is Fufang, not Bianfang; the literal needs that place-name fix without embedding Chinese characters in the English field.

decisions.after: In year eleven he was killed by his own troops.
decisions.reason: s0073 十一年 is a calendar/regnal year eleven, not the eleventh year of Quanhao's personal rule; the proposal rightly drops that error, but this unit does not name the Xiantong era, so the parenthetical invents information.
s0026 ends 舉兵伐之 with no named subject; inventing Xiancheng as attacker contradicts the next unit (s0027), where he secretly supplies Tongjie, so the agentless passive is the correct fix.
s0017 司門郎中 is Director of the Bureau of Gates, not Secretariat Director; the proposed office title matches the Chinese.
The literal likewise mistranslates 司門郎中 as Secretariat Director; Director of the Bureau of Gates is the correct office.
s0175 李公佺 has 佺 (quán); Gongxian is a wrong reading of the given name, and Gongquan restores it.
Literal repeats Gongxian for 李公佺; Gongquan matches 佺.
s0176 公佺 is the short form of 李公佺; Gongquan, not Gongxian, is required.
Literal short form must likewise follow 公佺 as Gongquan.
In s0179 全忠女妻威子廷規，先是卒 the subject of 先是卒 is Quanzhong's daughter; s0180 助女葬事 confirms her funeral, so death cannot be attributed to Tinggui.
